# Nurse Staffing & Agency Reduction

- **Goal / definition of done:** reduce **agency/travel nurses from ~14% to under 6% of nursing
  hours** while holding safe ratios — the top controllable cost line.
- **Owner:** [Karen Osei](../people/karen-osei.md) (CNO), with Diane; finance case with
  [David Reinhart](../people/david-reinhart.md).
- **Status:** active; **on track** — internal float pool and a nurse-residency cohort are
  ramping; agency hours down modestly quarter-over-quarter.

## Levers
- Internal float/resource pool expansion; a sign-on/retention program; and Epic-enabled
  self-scheduling once [Phase 2](epic-optimization-phase-2.md) delivers it.
- Retention risk to watch: [David Coleman](../people/david-coleman.md) (ED) — separate from
  nursing but a bellwether for morale.
